opening.argument: The presentation centers on ordinary software workflows: a B2B portal tutorial covers searching for cruises, buying tickets, and servicing orders, while separate instructions show how to open a boarding report and connect a product by selecting Anchor and entering a product ID. Anchor is described as an operating and reservation tech system, and the API slide promotes product connectivity. These are concrete demonstrations of ticketing, reporting, and integration tools. Although the presentation promotes business use and connectivity, the supplied material does not describe a personal-profit promise or a deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: In this tutorial, you will learn how to navigate Hornblower's B2B portal, including how to search for cruises, buy tickets, service your orders, and more.
